newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins Japan Telecom order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins Japan Telecom order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Thursday it had received an order for an experimental wideband wireless multi-media system from Japan Telecom Co.
Ericsson said the system would be based on Ericsson's 5MHz wideband code division multiple access (WCDMA) technology.
"The purpose...is to carry out timely research of the WCDMA technology pioneered by Ericsson as the radio access method for third-generation mobile telephone systems," Ericsson said in a statement.
In-depth studies of radio technology and network management aspects will be carried out in 1998.

"Moreover...Japan Telecom plans to execute the experiments in order to facilitate the realisation of an entire range of new wireless mobile multimedia communications that require a wideband radio interface," Ericsson said.
Ericsson said the order from Japan Telecom was its second for a WCDMA experimental system.
